name: The eternal Word becomes flesh
summary: John opens his gospel identifying Jesus as the eternal Word, present with God from the beginning, who becomes flesh and dwells among humanity.

name: John the Baptist testifies he is only a voice preparing the way
summary: John the Baptist denies being the Christ and declares he is only a voice preparing the way for one greater than himself.

name: John the Baptist identifies Jesus as the Lamb of God
summary: Seeing Jesus approach, John the Baptist proclaims him the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world.

name: Andrew and Peter follow Jesus
summary: Andrew leaves John the Baptist to follow Jesus and brings his brother Simon, whom Jesus renames Peter.

name: Philip and Nathanael become disciples
summary: Jesus calls Philip directly, and Philip convinces the skeptical Nathanael after Jesus reveals he saw him under a fig tree.

name: Jesus turns water into wine at a wedding
summary: At his mother's request, Jesus turns six stone jars of water into wine at a wedding, his first public sign.

name: Jesus drives merchants from the temple courts
summary: Jesus overturns tables and drives out money changers and merchants from the temple courts, declaring it his Father's house.

name: Nicodemus visits Jesus by night
summary: A Pharisee named Nicodemus comes to Jesus at night and is told that no one can see the kingdom of God without being born again.

name: John the Baptist declares that he must decrease
summary: As Jesus' following grows, John the Baptist tells his own disciples that Jesus must increase while he himself decreases.

name: Jesus offers a Samaritan woman living water
summary: Jesus asks a Samaritan woman for water and offers her living water, revealing he already knows her whole life story.

name: The Samaritan woman brings her town to Jesus
summary: The woman leaves her jar and tells the town about Jesus, and many Samaritans come out to hear him and believe.

name: Jesus heals an official's son from a distance
summary: A royal official begs Jesus to heal his dying son, and the boy is healed the moment Jesus speaks the word.

name: Jesus heals a man who had been sick for thirty-eight years
summary: Jesus heals a man who has been unable to walk for thirty-eight years, on the Sabbath, simply by telling him to rise.

name: Jewish leaders accuse Jesus of blasphemy
summary: Religious leaders seek to kill Jesus for healing on the Sabbath and for calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

name: Jesus feeds five thousand people
summary: Jesus multiplies five loaves and two fish to feed a crowd of five thousand, with twelve baskets of food left over.

name: Jesus walks on the sea to his disciples
summary: During a storm at night, Jesus walks across the sea to reach his disciples' boat, and immediately they arrive at the shore.

name: Jesus teaches that he is the bread of life
shortName: I am the bread of life
summary: After the crowd seeks him for more food, Jesus declares himself the bread of life and says whoever comes to him will never hunger.

name: Many disciples turn away from Jesus
summary: Jesus' hard teaching about eating his flesh and drinking his blood causes many disciples to leave, but Peter affirms the Twelve will stay.

name: Jesus teaches openly at the Feast of Booths
summary: Jesus goes up to Jerusalem for the Feast of Booths and teaches openly in the temple, dividing the crowd's opinion about him.

name: Officers sent to arrest Jesus return empty-handed
summary: Temple officers sent by the Pharisees to seize Jesus return without him, astonished, saying no one ever spoke the way he does.

name: Jesus forgives a woman caught in adultery
summary: Scribes and Pharisees bring a woman caught in adultery to Jesus, who tells the one without sin to cast the first stone.

name: Jesus declares that he is the light of the world
shortName: I am the light of the world
summary: Teaching in the temple, Jesus declares that whoever follows him as the light of the world will never walk in darkness.

name: Jesus tells his hearers the truth will set them free
shortName: The truth will set you free
summary: Jesus tells the Jews who believed him that knowing the truth will set them free, provoking a dispute over Abraham's true children.

name: Jesus heals a man born blind
summary: Jesus heals a man blind from birth by anointing his eyes with mud and sending him to wash in a nearby pool.

name: Pharisees interrogate and expel the healed man
summary: Pharisees refuse to believe the miracle, interrogate the man and his parents, and expel him from the synagogue for defending Jesus.

name: Jesus declares that he is the door for the sheep
summary: Jesus tells the Pharisees that he is the door, and whoever enters through him will be saved and find pasture.

name: Jesus declares that he is the good shepherd
summary: Jesus describes himself as the good shepherd who knows his sheep by name and lays down his life for them.

name: Jesus claims oneness with the Father at the Feast of Dedication
summary: At the Feast of Dedication, Jesus claims that he and the Father are one, and the Jews try to stone him for blasphemy.

name: Jesus declares that he is the resurrection and the life
shortName: I am the resurrection and the life
summary: Before raising Lazarus, Jesus tells the grieving Martha that he himself is the resurrection and the life for all who believe.

name: Martha confesses Jesus as the Christ
summary: Martha tells Jesus she believes he is the Christ, the Son of God who was to come into the world.

name: Jesus raises Lazarus from the dead
summary: Four days after Lazarus dies, Jesus calls him out of the tomb alive, the greatest of his signs in John's gospel.

name: Caiaphas prophesies that Jesus must die for the nation
summary: Alarmed by the raising of Lazarus, the chief priests plot Jesus' death, and Caiaphas unknowingly prophesies he will die for the nation.

name: Mary anoints Jesus' feet with costly perfume
summary: Mary anoints Jesus' feet with expensive perfume six days before Passover, and Judas Iscariot objects to the costly gift.

name: Jesus rides into the city on a donkey to a crowd's acclaim
summary: Crowds wave palm branches and hail Jesus as king as he rides in on a young donkey, fulfilling ancient prophecy.

name: Greeks seek Jesus and he predicts his death
summary: Greeks visiting the feast ask to see Jesus, prompting him to describe his coming death as a grain of wheat falling to bear fruit.

name: Jesus washes his disciples' feet
summary: At the last supper, Jesus washes his disciples' feet as an example of humble service, despite Peter's initial objection.

name: Jesus gives the new commandment to love one another
summary: Jesus tells his disciples that love for one another is the mark by which everyone will know they belong to him.

name: Jesus predicts Judas' betrayal and Peter's denial
summary: Jesus identifies Judas as his betrayer at the table and tells Peter he will deny knowing him three times before dawn.

name: Jesus declares that he is the way, the truth, and the life
shortName: I am the way, the truth, and the life
summary: Jesus comforts his troubled disciples, telling Thomas that he is the way, the truth, and the life, the only path to the Father.

name: Jesus promises the Holy Spirit as a helper
summary: Jesus promises to send the Holy Spirit to teach his disciples and remind them of everything he has told them.

name: Jesus declares that he is the true vine
summary: Jesus teaches that he is the true vine and his disciples are the branches who must remain in him to bear fruit.

name: Jesus warns the disciples that the world will hate them
summary: Jesus warns his disciples that the world will hate them just as it hated him, since a servant is not greater than his master.

name: Jesus promises the Spirit will guide the disciples into truth
summary: Jesus tells his disciples it is better for him to go so the Helper can come, who will guide them into all truth.

name: Jesus promises their sorrow will turn to joy
summary: Jesus compares the disciples' coming grief to a woman's labor pains, promising their sorrow will turn into lasting joy.

name: Jesus prays for his own glorification
summary: Before his arrest, Jesus lifts his eyes to heaven and prays that the Father will glorify him as he has glorified the Father.

name: Jesus prays for the unity of his disciples and future believers
summary: Jesus prays for his disciples' protection from the world and for the unity of everyone who will believe through their message.

name: Judas betrays Jesus to arresting soldiers
place: the garden across the Kidron Valley
summary: Judas leads a detachment of soldiers and officers to seize Jesus, and Peter cuts off a servant's ear with his sword.

name: Jesus is questioned before the high priest Caiaphas
summary: Jesus is bound and brought before Caiaphas the high priest for questioning about his teaching and his disciples.

name: Peter denies knowing Jesus three times
summary: Warming himself by a charcoal fire, Peter denies knowing Jesus three times before the rooster crows.

name: Pilate questions Jesus and the crowd chooses Barabbas
summary: Pilate finds no guilt in Jesus but offers to release a prisoner for Passover, and the crowd demands Barabbas instead.

name: Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified
summary: After having Jesus flogged and mocked with a crown of thorns, Pilate presents him to the crowd and hands him over to be crucified.

name: Jesus is crucified between two criminals
summary: Jesus is crucified outside the city at a place called Golgotha, with soldiers casting lots for his garment as prophecy foretold.

name: Jesus entrusts his mother to the beloved disciple
summary: From the cross, Jesus sees his mother and the disciple he loved standing nearby and entrusts them to care for one another.

name: Jesus dies and Joseph of Arimathea buries him
place: a new tomb in a garden
summary: After Jesus dies and a soldier pierces his side, Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap his body and lay it in a new tomb.

name: Mary Magdalene discovers the stone rolled away
summary: Mary Magdalene finds the stone rolled away and runs to tell Peter and the beloved disciple, who race to see the empty tomb.

name: The risen Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene
summary: Weeping outside the tomb, Mary Magdalene mistakes the risen Jesus for a gardener until he speaks her name.

name: Jesus appears to the disciples and breathes the Spirit on them
summary: Jesus appears among his disciples behind locked doors, shows them his wounds, and breathes on them, telling them to receive the Holy Spirit.

name: Thomas doubts the resurrection and then believes
summary: A week later Jesus appears again and invites the doubting Thomas to touch his wounds, prompting Thomas to confess him as Lord and God.

name: Jesus provides a miraculous catch of fish
summary: Jesus appears by the sea and directs the disciples to a catch of fish so large their net nearly breaks.

name: Jesus restores Peter and tells him to feed his sheep
summary: Jesus asks Peter three times whether he loves him, restoring him after his denials and commissioning him to care for his flock.
